description.vi: Website cửa hàng quà lưu niệm du lịch bố cục một trang, một nút lớn: menu nổi, tiêu đề chữ lớn, ảnh vòm viền tem thư; "Tìm quà" theo người nhận (gia đình, đồng nghiệp, bạn bè, bản thân) và ngân sách, ra số món hợp rồi lọc sẵn; cửa hàng lọc theo loại quà, vùng miền, người nhận, mức giá; mỗi món một trang với cỡ hoặc gói đổi giá, màu, ô gói quà cộng tiền, trong gói có gì, chất liệu, trọng lượng; dịch vụ gói quà, viết thiệp, gửi đi nước ngoài, mua theo đoàn; giỏ hàng và phí giao.
description.en: A one-page, one-big-button souvenir shop website: floating menu, big serif headline and an arched photo with a stamp-edge frame; a gift finder by recipient (family, colleagues, friends, yourself) and budget that counts matches and filters the shop; filters by gift type, region, recipient and price; a page per item with size or pack pricing, colours, a gift-wrap option that adds to the price, contents, material and weight; services for wrapping, cards, shipping abroad and group orders; a cart with delivery fees.

q.vi: Tiệm có gửi quà đi nước ngoài không?
q.th: ส่งไปต่างประเทศไหม?

a.vi: Có, qua bưu điện quốc tế, có mã theo dõi. Thời gian 7–14 ngày tùy nước; tiệm báo phí trước khi gửi.
a.en: Yes, by international post with tracking, 7–14 days depending on the country. We quote the fee before sending.
a.th: ส่งได้ ทางไปรษณีย์ต่างประเทศ มีเลขติดตาม 7–14 วันแล้วแต่ประเทศ ร้านแจ้งค่าส่งก่อน

q.vi: Mang đồ sơn mài, gốm lên máy bay được không?
q.en: Can I take lacquer and pottery on a plane?
q.th: นำเครื่องรักและเครื่องปั้นขึ้นเครื่องบินได้ไหม?

a.vi: Được. Tiệm bọc chống sốc miễn phí và có thể đóng hộp vừa hành lý xách tay.
a.en: Yes. We pack them in protective wrap for free and can box them to fit hand luggage.
a.th: ได้ ร้านห่อกันกระแทกฟรี และจัดกล่องให้พอดีกระเป๋าถือขึ้นเครื่อง

q.vi: Đặc sản khô để được bao lâu?
q.en: How long do the treats keep?
q.th: ของกินเก็บได้นานแค่ไหน?

a.vi: Trái cây sấy, me, xoài 6 tháng; cà phê 12 tháng. Hạn dùng in trên từng gói.
a.en: Dried fruit, tamarind and mango 6 months; coffee 12 months. The date is printed on each pack.
a.th: ผลไม้อบแห้ง มะขาม มะม่วง 6 เดือน กาแฟ 12 เดือน วันหมดอายุพิมพ์บนทุกห่อ

q.vi: Mua cho đoàn có giảm giá không?
q.th: ซื้อเป็นกลุ่มมีส่วนลดไหม?

a.vi: Từ 20 món giảm 10%. Tiệm chia túi sẵn cho từng người và giao về khách sạn.
a.en: 10% off from 20 items. We pack a bag per person and deliver to your hotel.
a.th: ตั้งแต่ 20 ชิ้นลด 10% ร้านแยกถุงให้แต่ละคนและส่งถึงโรงแรม
